summary.text: Terry Brown, listed by Ballotpedia as Terry Brown Jr., is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 92 since January 1, 2021, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Brown earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Charlotte and a J.D. from Campbell University Law School.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as a political director, campaign manager and litigator.
He first took office in 2021, succeeding Chaz Beasley, a fellow Democrat.

For the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists Brown as a member of the Appropriations, Appropriations on Health and Human Services, Energy and Public Utilities, Insurance, Judiciary III, Regulatory Reform, and UNC BOG Nominations committees.
